description: A server that refuses lingering both ways there are without a password, as with no polkit and no passwordless sudo. The install says so in `notes`, and the host's row has `needs_admin`, which Settings shows with its one button (hosts.admin).

notes: Lingering couldn't be turned on, so vibed stops when you log out of refuses@strict.example.com. Settings → Hosts has a button that does it, asking for the password there once.
